name: Amayadori
source:
Time starts to flow very fast with every day being busy and without a moment to spare. Main character sees a girl stilling alone in the rain and lends her a hand. Girl's name is Mio.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/03/vn-of-month-september-2001-eve-fatal.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
每天都忙得没有片刻空闲，时间也仿佛流逝得越来越快。主人公看见一名少女独自站在雨中，于是向她伸出援手。少女名叫美绪。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/03/vn-of-month-september-2001-eve-fatal.html]vndbreview[/url]]
